diagnosedIssues: Type optional ingestion metadata is validated through JsonSchema before storage; no unsafe cast into persistent values.
Initial 281-test run had 2 failures: illegal filename/format errors reached Fastify default handling. Registered sanitized error handler before routes; retained 400 and requestId/secret assertions.
Caught I/O conflict errors preserve cause internally; public messages remain sanitized.
Serialized artifact quota/publication and final record update prevent concurrent overrun; cancellation uses the latest snapshot at commit.
Final typecheck/lint/build/288 tests plus 5 browser cases passed.
limits: S06 extraction/merging/embedding/indexing unimplemented; awaiting_indexing explicitly parks parsed work, never fake processed.
No document-pipeline model calls/charges in S05; model-stage cancellation acceptance follows S06, existing connection-test cancellation regressed.
No G01-G12 reference algorithm acceptance, deletion/rebuild, retrieval/answering or actual external provider validation.
No automatic GC for original/artifact orphans or historical snapshots; physical disk use exceeds referenced-file quotas.
Schema v1 reads pre-S05 documents/jobs via optional extensions; older executables cannot read new fields/status.
Linux local filesystem only; no NFS/multi-host/other OS/physical-power-loss guarantee.
